quests.title: Optional: A Blank on the Chart
quests.text: Our chart leaves the {name:front_wyrmglass_crown/spires} {dir_from_giver:front_wyrmglass_crown/spires} blank, which offends me as a dwarf and as a keeper of records. Reach the Wyrmglass Crown by boat; the Shipwright at our stables sells them, and the crossing is safe on the shelf and the channel, away from the Kraken's deep water. Kill six Spire Eagles on those spires by day so a surveyor can look at the stone without being pecked for it.
quests.lesson: Island trip by boat; coin at the cap, no XP.

quests.title: Party: Silence for the Clan
quests.text: {name:rime_bell_warden} tolls over the {name:front_wyrmglass_crown/spires} {dir_from_giver:rime_bell_warden}, and the clan wants that bell silenced. That golem is an elite: gather a full party, take a boat each to the Wyrmglass Crown and break it. I've a payment ready and a space in the record for everyone who comes back.
quests.lesson: Optional group elite on the island.

quests.title: Bounty: The Clan's Standing Order
quests.text: The clan has placed another order for Rime Sinew, with an impressive number of signatures from dwarves staying home. Take a boat to the Wyrmglass Crown and hunt Rimehorn Rams by day on the {name:front_wyrmglass_crown/scree}. Bring me four Rime Sinew for payment. You can take this bounty again one hour after each turn-in; I'll keep the signatories busy finding your coin.
quests.lesson: Island salvage bounty: coin at the cap.

quests.title: Optional: No Claim on the Crown
quests.text: A branded coin has been wedged into the survey cairn at {name:r20_anchor_075} on The Wyrmglass Crown, as though a capstone could sign away an island. Take a boat from the Shipwright at our stables, follow the shelf and channel, and pry the brand-coin out of the cairn. The clan paid for a survey; it did not authorise a sale.

objectives.label: Pry the brand-coin from the survey cairn

quests.lesson: Optional island extension of the main line (chapter 3 on): one use, coin only.
